description: This PHP source file defines the AuthParams class within the OrangeHRM authentication module. The class implements AuthParamsInterface and manages user credential and attribute bag objects, providing accessor methods with cloning for encapsulation.

classes.name: AuthParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) class that encapsulates user authentication parameters, including user credentials and an attribute bag.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the credential and attribute bag properties with optional cloning.

methods.name: getCredential
methods.description: Returns a clone of the stored user credentials interface.

methods.name: getAttributeBag
methods.description: Returns a clone of the stored attribute bag interface.
